diffusicraft.resources.setting.gpuMemory: The most video memory terrain generation may use. Auto leaves 40% for the game, shaders and other programs. Takes effect after a restart.

diffusicraft.resources.device.cuda.toolt: Uses the NVIDIA CUDA runtime. Falls back to the CPU if it is not installed.
diffusicraft.resources.device.rocm.toolt: Uses your ONNX Runtime ROCm build. Falls back to the CPU if it is not set up.
